hero.title: Your business, on autopilot.
hero.subtitle: Meet Pilot — your AI business assistant that helps manage your customers, appointments, marketing, employees, and day-to-day operations.
hero.tagline: You run the business. Pilot handles the busywork.
hero.hubDetail: Pilot connects every part of your business

intro.title: The work never stops. Pilot helps you keep up.
intro.description: Every day, business owners switch between customers, schedules, employees, marketing, and a hundred other tasks. Connection Pilot brings all of it together — and Pilot takes care of the repetitive work so you can focus on what matters.

appointments.title: We book it. You don't have to.
appointments.subtitle: Appointments, orders, and customer requests — organized automatically.
appointments.closing: Less back-and-forth. More time to actually run your business.

marketing.title: Pilot knows your business. Let it handle your marketing.
marketing.subtitle: Give Pilot your website. It learns your business and creates your content.
marketing.description: Pilot reads your website and learns your services, products, brand, and story. It uses that knowledge to generate social media content that sounds like you — so you spend less time writing and more time running your business.
marketing.upcomingNote: Automatic social publishing is coming soon.

insights.title: Pilot doesn't just organize your business. It thinks ahead.
insights.subtitle: Pilot watches your business so you don't have to.
insights.description: Pilot analyzes your business information and identifies patterns, opportunities, and potential problems — before they become urgent.
insights.exampleNote: These are examples of the insights Pilot generates from your real business data.

examples.text: Your most booked service increased 28% this month.
Three customers haven't returned in six months. Would you like me to reach out?
You're expecting more appointments Thursday than usual. You may want another employee scheduled.

scheduling.title: Your team. Organized.
scheduling.subtitle: Employee scheduling without the headache.
scheduling.description: Connection Pilot helps you build schedules, manage employee availability, and communicate schedules to your team — all in one place. Pilot can even draft a schedule for you based on your business needs.

chat.title: Just ask Pilot.
chat.subtitle: One conversation. Your entire business.
chat.disclaimer: The conversation below shows examples of what Pilot can do today and what it will be able to do as new capabilities are added.

messages.text: How did we do this month?
Revenue is up 12%. You had 83 customers, including 17 new customers. Your most booked service was your top package.
Create a post promoting our most popular service.
Done. I've created three options for you to review.
Schedule the best one for Friday.
Scheduled for Friday. I'll let you know when it goes live.

value.eyebrow: Built for the real cost of business
value.title: Built by people who understand what it costs to run a business.
value.description: Running a business is expensive. Software shouldn't make it harder.
value.body: Connection Pilot is built with small businesses in mind — giving you powerful tools without forcing you into expensive plans just to access the features you actually need.
value.closing: More tools. Less overhead. No unnecessary upgrades.

pillars.headline: More tools included
pillars.detail: Substantial functionality is built into lower-priced plans — not locked behind the next tier.

pillars.headline: Less overhead
pillars.detail: One platform replaces a stack of separate subscriptions. Fewer bills. Less to manage.

pillars.headline: Fewer unnecessary add-ons
pillars.detail: The features you actually need to run your business are included — not sold separately.

pillars.headline: More work handled by Pilot
pillars.detail: Pilot takes on the repetitive work so your team can focus on the work that actually moves the business forward.

cta.title: Meet Pilot.
cta.subtitle: Your smartest employee doesn't need a desk.
cta.description: Pilot learns how your business works, handles repetitive tasks, keeps everything organized, and helps you make better decisions.
cta.closing: You run the business. Pilot runs the busywork.
